Message flow: User Input -> I/O Conversion -> RequestConverter -> Interpreter (RUNNING) -> Agent Selection -> Agent Execution -> Response Collection -> StreamWrapper -> Backend -> User
State transition flow: INIT -> user sends message -> RUNNING -> Agent executes/Response sent -> STOP -> AutoChat? (if enabled) -> RUNNING (loop) OR Wait for user input -> RUNNING

Agent boundaries: Includes Role definition, Task execution, LLM interaction. Excludes Session management (Interpreter) and UI rendering (Backend)
Backend boundaries: Includes UI component rendering, Event handling, I/O format conversion. Excludes Conversation logic (Interpreter) and Agent management (Interpreter)
